Current RTL:
module counter_06 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] div_val,
  output clk_out
);

  reg clk_out_reg;
  reg [7:0] count_reg;
  reg [7:0] half_div_val;

  assign half_div_val = div_val / 2;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      clk_out_reg <= 1'b0;
      count_reg <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      if (count_reg == half_div_val - 1) begin
        clk_out_reg <= ~clk_out_reg;
        count_reg <= 8'd0;
      end else begin
        count_reg <= count_reg + 1;
      end
    end
  end

  assign clk_out = clk_out_reg;

endmodule

module counter_06 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] div_val,
  output clk_out
);

  reg clk_out_reg;
  reg [7:0] count_reg;
  reg [7:0] half_div_val;

  assign half_div_val = div_val / 2;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      clk_out_reg <= 1'b0;
      count_reg <= 8'd0;
    end else if (div_val == 0) begin
      clk_out_reg <= 1'b0;
    end else if (count_reg == half_div_val - 1) begin
      clk_out_reg <= ~clk_out_reg;
      count_reg <= 8'd0;
    end else begin
      count_reg <= count_reg + 1;
    end
  end

  assign clk_out = clk_out_reg;

endmodule
